thread:
maria: @channel seeing a sharp spike of 502/504s from hosted API in us-west-2 since ~09:43 UTC. Customer 'Horizon' reporting timeouts and 5xxs. Gateway logs show enqueue failures (request_queue_full) and continuous-batcher backlog growing fast. Ticket: https://redwood/support/INC-12345

devon: copying in. Can you paste the ingress metrics (queue depth p50/p95), drop counts, and which pool/model is impacted?

maria: p50 queue depth ~300, p95 ~1200 (config max 1024). drop_count increased from 0 -> 540 in 10m. dequeue latency p95 jumped to ~3.1s. Affected pool: hosted-prod-8, model: gptx-3.5-compat. Backlog gauge (continuous-batcher.backlog) ~820.

sam: that explains the 5xxs — requests are hitting the queue capacity then tail-timeouts as batchers drain slowly. Most returns are 503 (over capacity) but tail requests get 504.

maria: example log snippet from gateway: ```
[09:46:12] ERROR request_enqueue: tenant=horizon id=abcd1234 reason=request_queue_full pool=hosted-prod-8
[09:46:13] WARN dequeue_slow: pool=hosted-prod-8 dequeue_ms=3120 backlog=812
[09:46:15] ERROR handler_timeout: request_id=xyz timeout_ms=60000 status=504
```

devon: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase queue_capacity on hosted-prod-8 from 1024 -> 2048; 2) disable continuous batching on that pool to force immediate dispatch and let the backlog drain; 3) throttle the tenant if needed. I'll apply change and report.

jen: +1 to quick mitigation. Also notify CS and set customer-facing note. We should avoid full restart if possible. Suggest enabling a short-lived surge window rather than permanent config.

devon: applied change: ```
# increase queue cap
redwoodctl pool update hosted-prod-8 --queue-capacity=2048
# disable continuous batching
redwoodctl pool update hosted-prod-8 --continuous-batching=false
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: config change applied by devon at 09:58 UTC — queue_capacity=2048, continuous_batching=disabled.

maria: after changes error rate dropped from ~12% -> 1.2% within 6m. Customer reports latency improved. Continuing to monitor. :thumbsup:

support-bot: customer Horizon notified (INC-12345). CS rep assigned: @alex. Billing note: potential spike due to retries — flag for review.

sam: preliminary root cause: large sustained longseq traffic from horizon-proj (multiple concurrent requests with seq_len > 6k) caused KV cache pressure and order-of-arrival stalls for batchers, so backlog grew and hit queue cap. When backlog > pool threshold, tail-latency cascades.

jen: action items: 1) postmortem with timeline + graphs, 2) add runbook step to auto-scale queue capacity when backlog > 60% for >2m and p95 dequeue > 1s, 3) add tenant-level longseq safeguards (reject or reroute really long sequences to dedicated lanes), 4) evaluate smaller batch-size policy to avoid long blocking batches.

devon: filing incident INC-12345-PO (postmortem). I'll also create a short-term policy to auto-toggle continuous batching off if backlog growth rate > X. Linking diagnostic traces and heap of metrics to ticket.

maria: marking mitigation successful for now. Re-open if 5xxs exceed 2% in the next 30m. Closing thread here.
